research_question: Does splitting the early/late SEND/SKIP actor output mapping into two independent heads (shared trunk unchanged) improve cross-seed on-time task retention and metered cost, relative to the accepted ROUND58 shared-head actor?

structural_intervention.single_change: OLD shared action_head -> NEW two independent heads early_head + late_head on the same shared trunk
structural_intervention.routing: ready_step = round(f[18]*1000) - round(f[0]); ready_step <= 147 -> early_head; ready_step > 147 -> late_head
structural_intervention.routing_inputs: legal 19-dim observation + frozen constant only; no task outcome, receiver knowledge, scenario id or target id
structural_intervention.routing_is_not_an_action_rule: early may still SEND, late may still SKIP; no hard send/skip, no extra emission, sequential budget mask never bypassed
structural_intervention.initialization: both heads are exact deepcopies of the OLD action_head (independent parameter objects, no RNG draw); trunk and dual critic taken unchanged from each seed's verified R58 ep0 model; ep128 and any OLD Adam/lambda are NOT loaded
structural_intervention.unchanged: shared trunk, task-value head, cost-value head, critic->trunk gradient isolation, beta=1.00 ready_cut=147 gate prior (now acting through the routed early head), 19-dim obs, one-shot SEND/SKIP, sequential budget mask

frozen_living_config_verified_from_r58_e.note: module import defaults gae_lambda=0.95/eta_lambda=0.05 are the OLD values and are NOT used; the live overrides 1.0/0.5 are asserted at import

new_contract.old_single_head_resume: rejected as NEW training-resume source; accepted only as model-only initialization source

fixed_plan.new_training_breakdown: 3 seeds x 128 episodes (first 4 of each seed count toward the 128)
fixed_plan.new_model_eval_breakdown: NEW x 3 seeds x {greedy,sampled} x 32 scenes
fixed_plan.readonly_reuse_breakdown: R58 same-seed/mode 192 cells (3 seeds x 2 modes x 32 scenes) + immediate/late rule 64 cells; NOT counted as new launches
fixed_plan.training_scene_order: frozen 48-scene order 1300000..1300047 repeated to 128 per seed (inherited unchanged)
fixed_plan.eval_block: 1700000..1700031 (32 scenes, fixed; already used for analysis/method selection; development ablation, not an unseen confirmation set)
fixed_plan.primary_comparison: NEW - R58, same seed, same mode, same scene; greedy is the primary reading, sampled reported independently
fixed_plan.statistics: scene is the pairing unit; R58 32-scene ordering, shared bootstrap index and interval convention reused; no seed pooling, no treating the two modes as independent repeats, no new statistical method
